ov: Three species of bats from Central and South America, the only mammals that feed only on blood. They find warm spots on sleeping animals with heat sensors on the nose, cut the skin with razor-sharp teeth and lap up the blood. Unlike most bats, they can walk, jump and run.

why.dg: The common vampire bat sometimes feeds on sleeping people, and it carries rabies.
why.ac: It approaches sleeping animals at night to feed on their blood.

len: About 9 cm, with an 18 cm wingspan (common vampire bat)
df: Blood, mostly from livestock for the common vampire bat; the hairy-legged vampire bat feeds on birds.
fx: A vampire bat can survive only about two days without feeding.
In the wild they live about nine years on average.
notes: Group entry (iu is for the common vampire bat). The animals.js fact is confirmed: bats that fed regurgitate blood for hungry colony members, and reciprocity predicts who helps whom.
